summary: {elections_official} starts a polling-place change when the return inspection finds a barrier still there.
realLife: Merced agreed to have an independent architect revisit outside polling sites and to replace a site if listed barriers remained under the settlement timetable.
gates: A return inspection has found an unresolved polling-site barrier.
inGame: needs: the reinspection result and the survey of the proposed new polling place.

turns.what: Election staff reassign the location and prepare voter notices.
turns.writesBack: The precinct record names the replacement site.

turns.what: The architect sends staff back to the search.
turns.pulledBy: The proposed replacement has an inaccessible approach.
